description: The one window, and only what a window needs. The shell reaches its own files over frank:// and Studio over fetch; the ONE command it calls is sync_discover (job 26, 6 Sep) -- the Bonjour browse behind the Sync button -- through window.TTSTVHost, which lib.rs injects. Nothing else beyond core:default is granted. NOTE what is deliberately absent: tauri-plugin-deep-link is registered in lib.rs (job 23d, 6 Sep) and gets NO permission here, so none of its commands are reachable from the page. The link is read in Rust and the pairing is written into localStorage from there; a page that could call get_current() could read the pass out of the launch URL, and no page needs to.
